name: KiwiKraft Performance
description: Precision engineered performance parts for the modern racer.
story: KiwiKraft Performance was founded by a group of motorsport enthusiasts in Auckland, dedicated to creating the ultimate performance parts. Inspired by New Zealand's rich racing heritage, KiwiKraft seeks to partner with teams who share their commitment to innovation and pushing the boundaries of performance. They value strong partnerships that reflect Kiwi ingenuity and a drive for excellence.
